$comment: Provenance of every art asset in the game. Every file under public/art/ must match an entry (tests/content/art-assets.test.ts). No asset was downloaded, traced, generated by an image model, or taken from another game: all of it is original work produced by code in this repository.
projectLicense: No LICENSE file has been chosen for this repository yet, so all rights are reserved by the owner. The assets below are original work made for this project and are covered by whatever licence the owner chooses.

assets.what: Ground layer of the lower market (paving, earth, dry grass, grit, litter, low wall tops, the north city wall) with the shadows and occlusion of every standing thing baked in; morning ('day') and later-day ('late'), full and half resolution.
assets.origin: Rendered offline with Blender 5.2 (Cycles) by tools/art/build_market.py from the game's jerusalem-market tile map. Geometry and materials are procedural (tools/art/lib/*.py): no image textures, scanned or downloaded models, or photographs.
tools: Blender 5.2.2 LTS (GPL; used as an authoring tool only, not distributed)

assets.what: Sun-visibility mask of the market ground (white = sunlit), used to dim and cool people who stand in shade.
assets.origin: Rendered by tools/art/build_market.py (white material override, sun only).

assets.what: Atlas pages of every standing thing in the market (houses, stalls, trees, props, animals, signs), each rendered on its own with the rest of the market still casting shadows and bouncing light onto it.
assets.origin: Rendered by tools/art/build_market.py; procedural geometry and materials.

assets.what: Placement, sorting and atlas coordinates of the market layers.
Character sprite sheets (idle, breathing, blink, talking, walking, turning; four directions) and their cast-shadow sheets, for morning and later-day light.
assets.origin: Rendered offline with Blender 5.2 (Cycles) by tools/art/build_people.py. Each person is built procedurally from the game's character appearance data (tools/art/lib/people.py): a body grown along a joint skeleton, lofted garments, head and face parts, and our own forward kinematics and skinning for every pose.

assets.what: Frame layout, origins and appearance keys of the character sheets.
Portraits of every character and player look (head and shoulders, 512 px masters with 256 and 128 px copies) for the dialogue box, the profile picker and chapter select.
assets.origin: Rendered offline with Blender 5.2 (Cycles) by tools/art/build_portraits.py from the characters' appearance data. Heads are sculpted in code as signed distance fields (tools/art/lib/portrait_head.py); skin, eyes, hair (Blender hair curves), cloth and the backdrop are procedural (tools/art/lib/portrait*.py). No image textures, scanned or downloaded models, photographs or image-generation models.
tools: Blender 5.2.2 LTS (GPL; used as an authoring tool only, not distributed)

assets.what: Which portraits exist and the appearance key each was rendered from (bundled with the menus, so no request is needed to find them).
Every place without pre-rendered art (and people with story marks) is painted at runtime by these Canvas 2D painters.
Interface icons, portraits and illustrations drawn as inline SVG.

assets.origin: @fontsource packages of Alegreya, Atkinson Hyperlegible and OpenDyslexic.
